name: Pregnant Roommates, Send Help!
source:
You answered a listing for a suspiciously cheap room in a shared house.

The catch: five roommates, all pregnant, all with their own reasons for being there, and none of them expected someone like you to show up.

Morri keeps to herself and pretends she's fine. Sunny plays co-op until 3am and acts like nothing's heavy. Julia has a spreadsheet for everything, except feelings. Luna knows things about you she shouldn't. Camilla will cook an entire feast just to avoid silence.

What starts as the worst housing decision of your life turns into something you didn't see coming. Five women, five stories, one house that's louder and warmer than any of them planned for.

In Pregnant Roommates, Send Help, you'll navigate daily life, uncover what each of them is hiding, and decide how close you want to get, one choice at a time.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4592410/Pregnant_Roommates_Send_Help/]Steam[/url]]
